blocks.text: Досі ви казали про те, що є зараз: I am at home. Тепер ви навчитеся розповідати, що було: «вчора я був удома», «на Різдво ми були разом», «у сумці було дві прищіпки». Для цього в скріпки є минула форма.

examples.en: I was at home yesterday.
We were together at Christmas.
There were two clothes pegs in the bag.
Was it warm in spring?

blocks.text: У скріпки дві минулі форми. Де було am та is — тепер was: I was, she was, it was. Де було are — тепер were: you were, we were, they were. Українською «був, була, були» змінюються за родом, а тут — лише за «хто».

examples.en: I was at home yesterday.
She was in London last year.
We were at home last night.
They were in London at New Year.
examples.translation: На Новий рік вони були в Лондоні.

examples.en: The hairdresser was busy yesterday.

fixes.wrong: I were at home yesterday.
fixes.right: I was at home yesterday.

fixes.wrong: We was at home last night.
fixes.right: We were at home last night.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday I at home.
fixes.right: I was at home yesterday.

sections.title: Мітки минулого: yesterday, last night, on Sunday

blocks.text: Зазвичай у фразі є слово, що показує минуле: yesterday — «учора», last night — «учора ввечері», last year — «торік». Свята й дні — з at та on: at Christmas, at New Year, on Sunday.

examples.en: I was at home on Sunday.
We were together at Christmas.
They were in London at New Year.
examples.translation: На Новий рік вони були в Лондоні.

examples.en: The sports centre was closed yesterday.

fixes.wrong: We were together on Christmas.
fixes.right: We were together at Christmas.

fixes.wrong: I was at home in Sunday.
fixes.right: I was at home on Sunday.

blocks.text: Якщо мова про вчора — was чи were. Якщо про зараз — is чи are, як раніше. Слово yesterday чи now одразу підказує: Yesterday my towel was wet. The shower curtain is dry now.

examples.en: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.
examples.translation: Учора мій пляжний рушник був мокрий.

examples.en: Yesterday my flip-flops were dirty.
The shower curtain is dry now.
The bathroom mirror was dirty yesterday.
examples.translation: Учора дзеркало у ванній було брудне.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday my beach towel is wet.
fixes.right: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday my flip-flops was dirty.
fixes.right: Yesterday my flip-flops were dirty.

drill.question: Учора рушник був мокрий. Як сказати?
drill.optionA: Yesterday my beach towel is wet.
drill.optionB: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.

sections.title: Те, що не рахують штуками, — was

blocks.text: Як і в уроці 4, те, що не рахують штуками — крем, їжа, сік, — бере форму для одного: was, а не were. Yesterday the sun cream was in my bag.

examples.en: Yesterday the sun cream was in my bag.
examples.translation: Учора крем від сонця був у моїй сумці.

examples.en: The apple juice was cold yesterday.
The hot chocolate was too sweet yesterday.
examples.translation: Учора гарячий шоколад був надто солодкий.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday the sun cream were in my bag.
fixes.right: Yesterday the sun cream was in my bag.

fixes.wrong: The baby food were in the cupboard.
fixes.right: The baby food was in the cupboard.

blocks.text: «Не» ставлять як завжди — одразу після скріпки: It was not my day off. The fried egg was not cold. Для кількох — were not.

examples.en: It was not my day off.
The fried egg was not cold.
The peanut butter was not on the table.
examples.translation: Арахісової пасти не було на столі.

fixes.wrong: It not was my day off.
fixes.right: It was not my day off.

fixes.wrong: The fried egg didn't cold.
fixes.right: The fried egg was not cold.

blocks.text: Питання — як в уроці 2: скріпку наперед. Was it warm in spring? Were you at home in autumn? Коротко відповідають теж скріпкою: Yes, it was. No, it was not. Do і did тут не потрібні.

examples.en: Was it warm in spring?
Were you at home in autumn?
Was your pancake hot?
Were the scrambled eggs hot?
Yes, it was.

fixes.wrong: It was warm in spring?
fixes.right: Was it warm in spring?

fixes.wrong: Were your pancake hot?
fixes.right: Was your pancake hot?

fixes.wrong: Yes, it did.
fixes.right: Yes, it was.

blocks.text: Щоб сказати, що десь щось було, беруть there is з уроку 4 і змінюють is на was: There was a towel rail in the bathroom. Якщо речей кілька — There were: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.

examples.en: There was a bed sheet on the bed.
There were two clothes pegs in the bag.
There was a public toilet near the station.
There were two taxi drivers near the station.
There was fruit salad in the bowl.

fixes.right: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.

fixes.wrong: In the bag were two pegs.
fixes.right: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.

blocks.text: З was зручно оцінювати минуле: That was a silly idea — «це була дурна ідея», The plan was sensible — «план був розумний». Для кількох речей — were: The rules were fair.

examples.en: That was a silly idea.
The plan was sensible.
The rules were fair.

fixes.wrong: I were at home yesterday.
fixes.right: I was at home yesterday.

fixes.wrong: We was at home last night.
fixes.right: We were at home last night.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday my beach towel is wet.
fixes.right: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday the sun cream were in my bag.
fixes.right: Yesterday the sun cream was in my bag.

fixes.wrong: Yes, it did.
fixes.right: Yes, it was.

fixes.wrong: There was two clothes pegs in the bag.
fixes.right: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.

fixes.wrong: We were together on Christmas.
fixes.right: We were together at Christmas.

blocks.text: Уся нова граматика уроку — дві форми: was для I, he, she, it і однієї речі, were для you, we, they і кількох. Решта — як з am, is, are.

sections.title: Що взяти з собою в практику

blocks.text: Було — was чи were. Не було — was not, were not. Питання — Was…? Were…?, відповідь — Yes, it was. Десь було — There was / There were. Учора — was, зараз — is.

examples.en: She was in London last year.
It was not my day off.
Were you at home in autumn?
There was a soap dish next to the washbasin.
